curated.lethality_detail_zh: 约75%初诊为非肌层浸润性膀胱癌(NMIBC)，易复发但5年生存率高；一旦进展为肌层浸润(MIBC)或转移性尿路上皮癌，长期预后骤降且易并发反复重度肉眼血尿膀胱血块填塞或上尿路积水肾衰。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) EV-302研究证实维恩妥尤单抗(Nectin-4 ADC)+帕博利珠单抗较传统铂类化疗将晚期尿路上皮癌中位总生存几乎翻倍(31.5 vs 16.1个月)，并于2024年8月在华获批；2) 国产原研HER2-ADC维迪西妥单抗联合特瑞普利单抗Ⅲ期研究(RC48-C016)在一线人群展现惊艳生存突破；3) FGFR3抑制剂(Erdafitinib)与BCG无应答NMIBC溶瘤/基因膀胱灌注(Nadofaragene firadenovec)实现更多保膀胱选择。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 卡介苗(BCG)供应稳定性及BCG无应答高危NMIBC保膀胱治疗仍面临缺口；一线ADC+PD-1双高值生物药联合自付负担沉重。

master.definition_en: An angle-closure glaucoma characterized by closure of the anterior chamber angle by an intrinsic defect such that aqueous outflow is blocked and the intraocular pressure becomes inappropriately elevated leading to optic nerve damage and visual field loss. Primary angle-closure glaucoma has symptom progressive peripheral vision loss, decreased vision, and pain, redness, and headache in acute cases. master.definition_en: B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (B-CLL) is a type of B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, and the most common form of leukemia in Western countries, affecting elderly adults (mean age of 67 and 72 years) with a slight male predominance (1.7:1), and characterized by a highly variable clinical presentation that can include asymptomatic disease or non-specific B-symptoms such as unintentional weight loss, severe fatigue, fever (without evidence of infection), and night sweats as well as cervical lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly and frequent infections. Some patients can also develop autoimmune complications such as autoimmune hemolytic anemia or immune thrombocytopenia. The clinical course is extremely heterogeneous with survival ranging from a few months to several decades.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 绝大多数患者病程长达数年至十余年，早期无症状甚至无需吃药；但晚期骨髓衰竭或免疫缺陷可引发致命性重症肺部感染/败血症、自身免疫性溶血性贫血(AIHA)，另有约2%–10%患者发生Richter转化（转化为高度侵袭性DLBCL），转化后数周至数月内迅速恶化。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 目前已全面迈入“无化疗口服靶向慢病管理时代”：早期无指征者仅需定期观察等待；有治疗指征者通过BTK抑制剂或BCL-2抑制剂(维奈克拉)有限疗程方案，5年生存率超85%–90%，绝大多数患者可长期高质量生活。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 维奈克拉启动期高度警惕肿瘤溶解综合征(TLS)：必须严格执行5周剂量爬坡(20→50→100→200→400mg)、充分水化并按肿瘤负荷预防性使用别嘌醇/拉布立酶及严密监测血钾/磷/尿酸; 2) 突发重症感染/中性粒细胞缺乏性发热：立即留取血培养并经验性覆盖广谱抗细菌及抗真菌/PCP治疗; 3) 急性溶血危象(AIHA)或免疫性血小板减少(ITP)：急予大剂量糖皮质激素或IVIG并避免盲目输血加重溶血。

master.name_en: autosomal recessive distal spinal muscular atrophy 1
master.definition_en: Spinal muscular atrophy with respiratory distress type 1 is a rare genetic motor neuron disease characterized by severe respiratory distress/respiratory failure in association with diaphragmatic eventration and palsy, as well as progressive, symmetrical, distal-to-proximal muscle weakness and atrophy (in lower limbs especially). master.definition_en: Herpes simplex virus encephalitis (HSE) is caused by the infection of the central nervous system by Herpes simplex virus (HSV) that could have a devastating clinical course and a potentially fatal outcome particularly with delay or lack of treatment. master.definition_en: Mosaic trisomy 7 is a rare chromosomal anomaly syndrome, with a highly variable phenotype, mostly characterized by blaschkolinear skin pigmentary dysplasia, body asymmetry, enamel dysplasia, and developmental and growth delay. Intellectual disability, facial dysmorphism (e.g. frontal bossing, abnormal palpebral fissures, strabismus, abnormally shaped ears, and micrognathia), and genital anomalies (e.g. undescended testes) have also been observed. It has been reported to be associated with maternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 7, resulting in a Silver-Russell syndrome phenotype. Cases with no associated malformations have also been reported.

master.definition_en: Citrullinemia is an autosomal recessively inherited disorder of urea cycle metabolism and ammonia detoxification characterized by elevated concentrations of serum citrulline and ammonia. The disease presents with a large range of manifestations including neonatal hyperammonemic encephalopathy with lethargy, seizures and coma; hepatic dysfunction in all age groups; episodes of hyperammonemia and neuropsychiatric symptoms in children or adults, or, can be asymptomatic in some cases (detected in newborn screening programs). Citrullinemia is divided into two main groups that are encoded by different genes: citrullinemia type I (comprised of acute neonatal citrullinemia type I and adult-onset citrullinemia type I) and citrin deficiency (comprised of adult-onset citrullinemia type II and neonatal intrahepatic cholestasis due to citrin deficiency).

master.name_en: CHRNG-associated hypo-akinesia disorder of prenatal onset
master.definition_en: A spectrum of presentations resulting from biallelic protein-altering variation in CHRNG. Inactivation of the receptor during early development leads to prenatal hypo-akinesia; subsequent phenotypes are a consequence of this hypo-akinesia and are thought to be dependent upon timing and severity of the anomaly at the neuromuscular junction. A range of phenotypes varying in severity (including both lethal and non-lethal presentations) have been reported, but typically include joint contractures, pterygia, dysmorphic features, vertebral and thoracic anomalies, and additional variable abnormalities. There are no clear genotype-phenotype correlations between the lethal and non-lethal presentations of this spectrum; both inter- and intra-familial variability have been reported, with the same variants being observed in both lethal and non-lethal cases.

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 告别“一经发现即晚期”，打破难治肿瘤的免疫屏障
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 胰腺癌、肝癌、晚期肺癌、卵巢癌等之所以致死率极高，核心在于早期几乎没有特异性感觉、发现太晚，且肿瘤被致密纤维基质与免疫抑制“盾牌”死死裹住。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推动一滴血极早期泛癌种微创早筛降本普及，开发打破癌巢基质屏障的新型核素偶联/双抗药物、通用型细胞免疫疗法与耐药逃逸实时监测。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 低丰度循环肿瘤 DNA/表观甲基化早筛模型、肿瘤空间微环境耐药逆转靶点挖掘。
